title: Zahi Hawass pumps out the Osiris shaft and opens the container

tellings.quote: time? Oh, I don't know, but so this was done by Zahi Hawass and team. They pumped all the water out so that they could lift the lid off of the container on the third level.

plain: Under Giza in Egypt there is a deep shaft with several levels, called the Osiris shaft. A team led by a man named Zahi Hawass pumped all the water out of it so they could lift the lid off a stone container on the third level, according to the researcher Jeffrey Drum. Drum tells it as part of his case that something important lies beneath the pyramids.
